about: Generation jobs for gpu/h3_control/run_jobs.py. Control videos come from `vrecon control scenes/<scene>.json --out controls/<scene>`.

defaults.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted geometry, flicker, extra objects, text, watermark, low quality

jobs.prompt: A small red cube slides slowly across a light wooden floor in a quiet, minimalist room. Behind it is a plain white wall. A gray concrete pillar stands on the left and a wooden crate sits on the right. Soft, even daylight. Realistic, sharp, natural colors.
